objective: Preallocate Fusion merge heaps from known iterator counts.

tasks.title: Preallocate Fusion merge heaps
tasks.result: Fusion compaction and visible-range merge heaps now reserve capacity from their candidate iterator counts.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
Compaction merge heap capacity now comes from the number of SSTable iterators in the compaction fan-in.
Visible-range merge heap capacity now comes from one write-buffer iterator plus memtable and SSTable iterator counts.
The optimization only changes BinaryHeap initial allocation; merge ordering, MVCC visibility, deduplication, visitor short-circuiting, compaction output, and DML behavior are unchanged.
The full sql_dml regression emitted existing SSTable retry warnings after passing; the command exited successfully.
